metrics.title: Metrics (optional)
metrics.description: Limit to specific XBRL concept names (e.g. ["Revenues","NetIncomeLoss"]). Leave empty to return the curated set of common financial-statement line items.

includeAllConcepts.title: Include all concepts
includeAllConcepts.description: Return every us-gaap concept the company reports (hundreds), not just the curated set. Overrides Metrics.

forms.title: Filing forms
forms.description: Only include data points from these filing forms.

minYear.title: Minimum year
minYear.description: Only include data points whose period ends in this year or later. Leave empty for full history.

latestOnly.title: Latest value only
latestOnly.description: Return only the most recent data point for each metric instead of full history.

maxRowsPerTicker.title: Max rows per ticker
maxRowsPerTicker.description: Cap fundamentals rows returned per ticker.

maxRowsTotal.title: Max rows total
maxRowsTotal.description: Stop after this many rows across all tickers.
